abstract: Having delineated the complete and the partial hydatidiform moles as 2 separate entities on the basis or morphology and cytogenetics, the authors studied 201 molar pregnancies at the Magee-Womens Hospital in an attempt to characterize the clinicopathologic profile of the partial mole syndrome. This was done mainly by comparison and contrast with the established and more familiar syndrome of the classic complete mole. The partial mole syndrome displays most of the pathologic and clinical features of the classic mole and seems to represent a milder, dilute version of the latter. This applies to placental morphology, to the fate of the embryo/fetus, and to human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) levels as well as to the incidence and severity of clinically persistent trophoblastic disease. Preeclampsia can be equally severe in both syndromes, but tends to occur later in patients with partial mole. No metastatic disease was encountered in association with partial moles and no case of overt choriocarcinoma has yet been described. The occurrence of trophoblastic disease (as determined by postoperative hCG titers) following partial moles requires further inquiry, including study of the pathology of the underlying lesion(s), which remain virtually unexplored.
abstract_ja: 完全胞状奇胎と部分胞状奇胎を形態学と細胞遺伝学に基づいて別個の疾患として区別したうえで、著者らはMagee-Womens病院で201例の妊娠奇胎を調べ、部分奇胎の臨床病理学的特徴を明らかにすることを試みた。これは主に、古典的な完全奇胎との比較によって行われた。部分奇胎症候群は、古典的奇胎の病理学的および臨床的特徴のほとんどを示し、より軽症で希薄化された型と考えられる。このことは、胎盤形態、胎児の転帰、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値、ならびに臨床的に持続する絨毛性疾患の発生頻度と重症度に当てはまる。子癇前症は両症候群で同等に重症となりうるが、部分奇胎では発症がより遅い傾向がある。部分奇胎の後には転移性疾患は認められず、顕性の絨毛癌もこれまで報告されていない。部分奇胎後の絨毛性疾患（術後hCG力価で判定）の発生については、基礎となる病変の病理学的検討を含め、さらなる検討が必要である。これらの点はほとんど未解明のままである。
